feedback.goal: Land the optimizer-ready trace evidence on run-record.v1: optional trace (ordered step projection with tool outcomes from the run-mode recorder), checks (per-check grader deltas with goal/actual state digests and deterministic detail), batch_id, and context.harness_pins — then re-run the tau-style e2e to produce populated records.

acceptance_criteria.statement: run-record.v1 gains additive optional sections (trace, checks, batch_id, context.harness_pins); old records and fixtures remain valid.
The run-mode recorder accumulates a capped ordered trace (seq/turn/step/tool/outcome/code) from session events and emits it in its records.
The e2e driver populates checks (with goal/actual digests and detail), batch_id, and harness_pins (skill + prompt digests).
A fresh tau-style batch runs under the exact still-valid approval and stores populated records; the gate stays green.

outcome.summary: Trace evidence shape shipped: the populate batch re-ran 5/5 and stored records carrying batch_id, per-check grader deltas with goal/actual digests, and harness pins; the recorder emits ordered tool traces; gate green.

what_worked: Schema-additive design kept every historical fixture valid without edits.
The recorder's trace pairs tool/call with the next tool/result in order (the session event map carries no callId on results), capped at 512 entries, names/codes only.
The populate batch reused the exact after-batch approval because the prompt manifest was unchanged — scope discipline held without a new decision.
what_failed: Docker Desktop stopped again before the populate batch; the daemon was restarted and the batch completed 5/5.

evidence.summary: Recorder trace assertion: tool bash with TIMEOUT_EXCEEDED projects to outcome timeout with code preserved; 26 focused tests pass.
Populate batch 5/5; stored records carry batch_id, checks with goal/actual state digests and detail, and harness_pins for skills + prompt (verified on run-e2e-task-001-refund-populate-54df1f20).
Typecheck, build, 129 tests, capsule checks, policy check, v0 suite, and benchmark suite all passed.

uncertainty.statement: The e2e driver cannot see in-session tool calls, so driver records carry no trace; trace population depends on run-mode recorder sessions (real dsh profile mount).
uncertainty.resolution: Mount the mode bundle in a workbench profile (approval-gated) so the recorder fills trace on real sessions; the schema and recorder path are already covered by tests.

notes: The populate batch reused the operator-approved after-batch decision (unexpired, exact prompt manifest); no new approval was needed.
